hero.titulo: Take care of your health, from home
hero.subtitulo: HomeTest is an at-home diagnostic testing service: you collect your own sample with no needles and no appointment, send it to our lab and get your results explained in the app.
hero.nota_legal: It does not replace your doctor. We help you understand signals to share with a healthcare professional.

pasos.descripcion: Choose your test and receive the kit at home in a few days, ready to use.
By yourself, with no needles and no appointment. Follow the instructions and send it with the prepaid label included.
We explain your results in the app, with clear recommendations to discuss with your doctor. It does not replace a professional medical assessment.
